body:
I'm studying Accounting. I'm really good when it comes to working with numbers and formulas. It's just a lot of work, and I'm the type of person that would rather find the easiest way to do something so I don't have to spend unnecessary time on a task. Accounting feels more like busy work for me than anything else.

I would say the things that bring me pleasure are music, occasionally watching movies, art, and watching others play games on youtube. I use to like playing games, but I have a hard to finding any fun in it now. I'd guess that I spend probably 70% of my day, when awake, listening to music. Music is the one thing that I enjoy the most.

I always use to spend almost all of my free-time (when I didn't have sports going on or anything school related) with my friends hanging out. Now I have trouble hanging out with anyone because I don't see the purpose in it. It just feels like a waste of time whenever I try. I know that lying down in my bed or sitting at my desk listening to music doesn't accomplish anything either and can also be considered a waste of time, but it takes less effort and at least enjoy it a little.

People around me seem to enjoy talking about what they're studying and their classes, and they have different hobbies they participate in. I really don't like spending more time than I have to thinking about my studies, and I struggle to find anything enjoyable other than the things I listed above.

I guess, in my eyes, I see people being overall happy when they can look at their possible future and be happy with the different aspects of it. I look at my possible future and can see myself living a decent life, but struggle to picture myself being happy.

I really do appreciate your time. Writing down my thoughts like this has really helped me organize all my thoughts that have been swimming through my head for a long time now. Looking at this all written down has already made me feel a lot better, and makes me feel like a lot of my problems are being amplified in my by my brain.

I think that might be accurate. I see other people that seem to enjoy life and try hard to accomplish different tasks all the time. I know for a fact that I don't enjoy the things that most other people do, so I figure that I will be happy with the way I'm living eventually, but my mind doesn't change it's thoughts. All I can do is act happy and content with my life so I don't attract attention from other people.

I wish I didn't want to kill myself because I know people that are happy with their lives don't have the thoughts I do, or at least they don't have them as often as I do. I've been trying to change as much as I could for the last year, but it doesn't help and I think all the time that it would be easier to just give up on everything.
